notes: Interest expense is untagged for FY2024-25, so the cost of debt falls back to rf + 1%.
D&A is tagged as Depreciation only (amortisation excluded), so historical FCF and the D&A ratio are slightly understated.
Capex/revenue jumped to 35% in FY2026 (AI build-out) from 12% in FY2021. The forecast uses the 6-year average (about 21%), not the latest year; the result is very sensitive to this.
EBIT is derived (pretax income + interest) because OperatingIncomeLoss is not tagged; FY2025 pretax includes large one-offs, so the last-year margin is elevated and mean-reverts.
Interest is InterestPaidNet (cash paid, not expense); used as the cost-of-debt proxy.
Total debt includes Cat Financial's captive-finance debt, which is backed by finance receivables. Subtracting all of it understates equity value; a later milestone may net it off.
Current long-term debt and commercial paper are both included in total debt; they are separate XBRL lines, but if the filer nests one in the other, debt is overstated by up to the CP amount.
Diluted shares fall back to basic (XOM reports identical basic and diluted EPS).
EBIT is derived (pretax income + interest). FY2020 includes impairments (negative EBIT), which pulls the mean margin down.
